## Motivation & Value
Why is this feature needed and what does it demonstrate?

## Proposed Implementation
Detailed technical approach and affected boundaries (`src/`, `examples/`, `tests/`).

## Guardrails & Non-Negotiables Check
- [ ] Does not add unnecessary complexity / bloated dependencies.
- [ ] Safe defaults preserved (no default unrestricted writes/Bash).
- [ ] Tested offline without requiring paid/live credentials by default.
